name: Stunning Pin
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Stunning Pin (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 122
You can render a pinned foe temporarily incapacitated.

Prerequisites: Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist.

Benefit: Whenever you pin an opponent, you can spend a swift action to make a Stunning Fist attempt against that opponent.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 133
You can spend 5 stamina points to use Stunning Pin as a free action instead of a swift action.
